Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

airport — a place where planes take off. Example: At the airport I show my passport.
flight — a journey by plane. Example: My flight leaves at nine.
gate — the door you use for a flight. Example: My flight leaves from gate 12.
passport — a document you need to travel abroad. Example: Here is my passport.
ticket — a paper that lets you travel. Example: I show my ticket at the airport.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where is gate ...?
• What time does the flight leave?
• Here is my passport.
• Go straight.
• Have a good flight!
